validation_not_run: docker build / docker compose config (worker has no shell or network)
npm run build:all (controller owns the script and server build config; added outside worker, not flagged as missing)
all runtime tests and cloud verification (no cloud account, by design)
assumptions: `npm run build:all` runs typecheck over src/, tests/, and tool/runtime sources (tools/), and the server entry lives under server/; therefore .dockerignore keeps src/, server/, tools/, tests/, config/, and all tsconfig/vite/vitest configs, and only excludes files not required by the build (prettier/eslint configs remain excluded).

Server enforces secure cookies under NODE_ENV=production (per .agents/architecture.md), so the local docker run must override NODE_ENV=development when SECURE_COOKIES=false; production default in the image is unchanged.

docker compose prefixes container and volume names with the project name, so backup/restore commands use `docker compose exec -T collect` and `docker compose cp` only; no bare `collect` container name or bare `collect-data` volume name is used.
ADMIN_TOKEN is validated against the env var and is not stored in the database; only session tokens are hashed in the DB (per frozen interface), so the runbook claim was corrected.

acceptance_mapping.persistent_volume_explicit: Dockerfile VOLUME /data + ENV DATA_PATH=/data/collection.db; compose named volume collect-data:/data; runbook warns against copying live WAL files and against scaling
acceptance_mapping.no_cloud_success_claimed: Runbook states user has no cloud account, nothing deployed or verified; no prices, pricing deferred to vendor sites
acceptance_mapping.secrets_excluded_from_build: .dockerignore excludes .env/.env.*/*.pem/*.key/private/materials/private/data participants/artifacts/logs/db; compose fails fast on missing ENTRY_CODE/ADMIN_TOKEN; admin export curl reads token from env and never from committed files

review_fixes: .dockerignore: documented keep-list for build/typecheck inputs (src, server, tools, tests, config, tsconfig/vite configs); prettier/eslint/editorconfig remain excluded as non-build inputs.
Runbook §3: local docker run now passes -e NODE_ENV=development alongside SECURE_COOKIES=false; production requirement kept (image default and compose unchanged).

Runbook §6: single online backup via VACUUM INTO into a timestamped unique file in /data, retrieved with `docker compose cp`; prefix-agnostic via compose commands; no chmod 777, no forced rm of previous backups, no bare collect/collect-data names; stop+restore rewritten as descriptive non-destructive steps.
Runbook §7: CSV curl URL now double-quoted so $DOMAIN expands.
Runbook §7: admin token claim corrected (env-var comparison, not hashed into DB; session token is the hashed one).
compose: removed deploy.replicas: 1; single-instance stated as operational design constraint, not compose-enforced.
Runbook §5/§4: removed concrete VM sizing (1-2 vCPU / 1-2 GB) and unconditional 'safe/enough' claims; HOST=0.0.0.0 wording now conditional on not publishing port 5200.
remaining: Controller to run docker build / docker compose config and repo tests (build:all, server build config, node24 typings, dist-server ignore are controller-owned and intentionally not flagged as missing).
User must obtain domain and (if desired) cloud account before any real deployment; ethics/protocol must be finalized before any real participant recruitment.
notes: Commit must be created by the controller (worker has no git tool). No source or package changes; diff kept well under budget.
